name: two men go on a date and don't fall in love
source:
Two men go on a date and don't fall in love. 
But maybe they can find something else in common?

[From [url=https://littlerat.itch.io/two-men-go-on-a-date-and-dont-fall-in-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个男人去约会，但没有坠入爱河。
但也许他们还能找到其他共同点？

[来自[url=https://littlerat.itch.io/two-men-go-on-a-date-and-dont-fall-in-love]Itch.io[/url]]
